explanation: EXCLURAD η-channel radiative correction computed successfully using EtaMAID-2023 model (model=3) with full O(α) corrections (rc_mode=0). Beam momentum: 6.53 GeV, inelasticity cut: 0.166 GeV². Results reported for unpolarized case (ipol=1, structure functions 1&4). Delta (δ = σ_obs/σ₀) = 1.1413042153 represents ~14.1% radiative enhancement. Sigma_Born (sibar(1)) = 0.0055907670 μb (Born cross section).
